gloss: waiting in vain; being stood up

definitions.gloss: waiting in vain (for someone who doesn't come)
definitions.explanation: Waiting for a person who does not come, or for something that does not happen. Almost always in {待|ま}ちぼうけを{食|く}う (to be kept waiting in vain, to be stood up).

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ちぼうけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}った→食う：02657_kuu⟧。
⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{待|ま}ちぼうけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}わされた。
examples.english: I was left waiting for a whole hour for nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{待|ま}ちぼうけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦させて→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I got the time wrong and left my friend waiting at the station.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ちぼうけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧: to be kept waiting in vain, to be stood up
- {待|ま}ちぼうけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}わせる→食う：02657_kuu⟧: to keep someone waiting in vain
- {待|ま}ちぼうけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up waiting for nothing

CULTURAL NOTE:
「{待|ま}ちぼうけ」 is also a well-known children's song with words by {北原白秋|きたはらはくしゅう}, based on the Chinese fable of the farmer who saw a rabbit run into a tree stump and then waited by the stump every day for another.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すっぽかす→すっぽかす：09316_suppokasu⟧: to stand someone up — said of the person who does not come
